rationale: At reviewed commit 3018a6591f54d3a37568db9c46dad0ddc0d32d90, the round-2 containment defect is fixed and no spec-branch-corrupting defect remains. I spot-ran the two mandated real-claim regressions: invocation from a subdirectory and through a symlink alias both refused a claim against dirty, entry-absent .gitignore state while their byte-identical/no-lifecycle-mutation assertions passed. I selected the symlinked .gitignore refusal variant as the requested third probe because it directly judges the disclosed leaf-symlink bonus bug; it passed, proving the dirty tracked symlink is matched by its own porcelain name and refusal remains a total no-op. Source inspection confirms toplevelOf canonicalizes the Git top-level, containedRel gates actual write targets by containment, and resolveContainingDirs resolves only ancestor directories while preserving the leaf basename. The focused runs passed uncached in 99.287s and 54.195s. The bead worktree remained clean at the reviewed SHA, and the self-cleaning /tmp fixtures left no probe directories behind.

findings.summary: Subdirectory and symlink-alias invocation can no longer disarm the entanglement guard.
findings.evidence: TestNextCmd_ClaimGuard_SubdirectoryInvocationRefusesByteIdentical and TestNextCmd_ClaimGuard_SymlinkAliasInvocationRefusesByteIdentical both passed against the reviewed commit.

findings.summary: The disclosed leaf-symlink correction preserves the tracked .gitignore name and fails closed.
findings.evidence: TestNextCmd_ClaimGuard_GitignoreVariantsRefuseByteIdentical/symlinked passed its real-binary refusal and byte-identical state audit. resolveContainingDirs leaves the leaf basename unresolved while canonicalizing its directory chain, matching Git porcelain semantics.

findings.summary: Review confinement and artifact identity were preserved.
findings.evidence: HEAD remained 3018a6591f54d3a37568db9c46dad0ddc0d32d90, git status and git diff remained empty, and no matching /tmp probe directories remained.
